2611.25357.image_caption: Figure 1: From codebase state to problem state. Existing AI research agents (gray) mainly iterate between code modification and code testing, using experimental results to select better implementations. Pro 2 Agent (full loop, including the blue and purple components) maintains an explicit understanding of the problem and uses experiments to do hypothesis testing to update this understanding and guide future implementations.

2611.25380.image_caption: Figure 1: Conventional weight-based RL. The harness sends the policy’s tool call to a Docker environment; the environment returns an observation and, at episode end, a scalar reward. The outer loop updates the policy weights.

2611.25429.image_caption: Figure 2: Overview of SkillPlumber . A persistent RCA agent uses coverage, execution traces, and permitted verifier feedback to diagnose a failure and revise the skill. It records its hypothesis and expected effect; a fresh execution provides evidence for the next revision decision. A maintainer shares investigative strategies across tasks. Coverage supplies instruction-use evidence to this self-evolution process.

2611.25476.image_caption: Figure 2 : Weight programs install new capabilities and keep existing behavior. (a) SCAN (a new verb in known compositions; a new combination of known words) and BabyAI before and after the program, with the weights each changes; gray, a rule-to-data reference trained on commands generated from the grammar (SCAN) and the best behavior cloning kept by the retention rule (BabyAI). (b) ImageNet ResNet-18: top-1 under corruption (95% intervals), net gain, and the change in clean top-1 on held-out ImageNet and on ImageNetV2; dashed red, the clean bound of the success criterion. (c) Net gain of every CIFAR-10 program, 10 of 12 above the best kept fine-tuning on its network; light bars, programs that do not meet the prespecified comparative criterion; diamonds, fine-tuning without the retention rule. Held-out test sets.

2611.25839.image_caption: Figure 12: 100 populations of 100 weights-as-genome replicators at each of four mutation rates p p ( s = 0.25 s=0.25 ), over 5,000 generations. (A) Mean accuracy of the viable organisms: the share of the 80 block-catch trials their controllers handle correctly (dotted: the ancestor’s 50%). (B) The share of organisms that are viable. In A and B: grey, single populations; black, the mean over populations, where at least 10 remain; red, the highest population in each generation; all running means over 20 generations. (C) The share of populations still going (Kaplan–Meier), and how they ended: done , at generation 5,000; extinct , no viable organism left; frozen , no child differed from its parent in any weight for 20 generations in a row; too slow , stopped short of generation 5,000 because it had become too slow to simulate, and counted as ended. At p = 10 − 4 p=10^{-4} , mean viability rises after generation 1,200 only because the populations that remain are those that kept it. At generation 5,000, from p = 10 − 4 p=10^{-4} to 3 ⋅ 10 − 6 3\cdot 10^{-6} , mean accuracy was 57%, 59%, 60% and 57%, and the best population reached 65%, 73%, 77% and 68%, mostly early (the best of all, at p = 10 − 5 p=10^{-5} , by generation 1,400). Viability fell from about 90% to 26%, 61% and 75% at p = 3 ⋅ 10 − 5 p=3\cdot 10^{-5} , 10 − 5 10^{-5} and 3 ⋅ 10 − 6 3\cdot 10^{-6} ; at p = 10 − 4 p=10^{-4} , 75 populations died out (median generation 1,327), at 3 ⋅ 10 − 5 3\cdot 10^{-5} , 12. Populations became too slow once every organism’s code differed from the ancestor’s, so that every string had to be run (about 100 instead of 3 seconds per generation); these 18 were stopped between generations 810 and 4,970.

2611.25868.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of StarTV-Agent. (A) ReAct-based Tool Orchestration: A shared VLM policy coordinates frozen traffic experts through task planning, tool selection, argument generation, and evidence verification. (B) Policy Learning: RSPO combines role-sensitive process and terminal advantages, while WDL provides targeted teacher demonstrations for weak tasks. (C) Inference with Experience Evolution: The agent follows a fast path by reusing suitable parameterized workflows or a slow ReAct-based path for adaptive reasoning. Label-free execution feedback guides workflow reuse and memory updates.

2611.25889.image_caption: Figure 1: Motivating example of EvoMem. (a) Base VLMs suffer from redundant frames and limited context. (b) HippoMM’s text-centric semantic memory may miss fine-grained visual evidence. (c) WorldMM lacks explicit temporal control for maintaining evidence chains. (d) Skill-free retrieval lacks guidance on what to seek, where to search, and when to stop. (e) EvoMem uses self-evolving skills for time-aware memory retrieval and coherent long-video reasoning.

2611.26007.image_caption: Figure 5: Policy execution and model adaptation in Zenless Zone Zero.

2611.26132.image_caption: Figure 1: Adaptive observation sustains recursive self-improvement. FixedObs (gray), which relies on anchor-only feedback, plateaus; AdaObs (blue) adapts the active observation by refining diagnosis (L1), escalating difficulty (L2), and adding related tasks (L3), before fusing validated gains back.

2611.26517.image_caption: Figure 5. Average runtime breakdown per iteration of Loop v2-p4 targeting wall-clock time.

2611.25214.image_caption: Figure 2 : Overview of EpiCompass . Hypothesis proposal and experimental testing change the agent’s epistemic state through two complementary pathways: belief update reassesses explored hypotheses against accumulated evidence, while exploration update identifies and refines promising directions in the unexplored hypothesis space. The updated state guides subsequent proposals and experiments. Hypothesis selection considers evidence support and novelty as indicators of anticipated epistemic gain, and final self-verification checks the proposed explanation against the complete epistemic tree.

2611.25235.image_caption: Figure 1: Distribution of the five memory classes by ground-truth stability score and validity horizon.

2611.25328.image_caption: Fig. 1: Unidirectional and bidirectional generator workflows.

2611.25446.image_caption: Figure 1: Traditional Frozen-PRM Training vs. Alternating Policy–PRM Training in PAIR-Med .

2611.25855.image_caption: Figure 1: Content-based memory method versus belief memory on a personalized order. The user has repeatedly rejected Penfolds wine and now asks for a bottle of wine without naming a brand. Content-based memory methods pass on fragments such as past purchases and a negative review, and agents using them order the wrong wine or none at all. HabitusMem infers that the user prefers mid-priced layered reds and rejects Penfolds, records the evidence, scope, and status of each belief, and leads the agent to the same order as the ground-truth profile.

2611.25925.image_caption: Figure 2: Overview of SpatialMem , which consists of three components: (1) a hierarchical memory tree for scene-task memory organization, (2) a memory construction and evolution module for trajectory updating and optimization, and (3) a memory retrieval module for adaptive specialist selection in quantitative spatial reasoning.

2611.26003.image_caption: Figure 3: Deployment of the original design in the full-cycle model of Steglich and Besson [41] , with the parameters of the magnesium alloy ZX10: (a) as cut, (b) crimped onto the balloon, (c) expanded by the balloon and (d) after the balloon’s release. Side views at one scale, axis upright, front half only, each with the stent’s outer diameter; the crimper and the balloon are not drawn. Colour: cumulative plastic strain, each element’s largest integration-point value. Bottom: the steps each model runs, with its run time on one or two CPUs. The reduced model used in the optimisation ( Section 4.2 ) covers only (c) and (d): it leaves out crimping, and a rigid cylinder expands the as-cut stent until the cylinder is 21.6 mm across and is withdrawn.

2611.26256.image_caption: Fig. 1: SkillBridge workflow. Static evidence triages skill-OS pairs; review produces OS-root-cause labels; repair edits contracts and replays target tasks. SkillFab.ai [ 25 ] provides the exchange substrate.

2611.26296.image_caption: Figure 1 : Three ways to improve agents. Text skills work with any model but cannot be optimized with gradients. LoRA is trained with gradients, but is model-specific. Skill.png (ours) encodes the skill as an image, optimized with gradients through one or more frozen models, and transfers across them.

2611.26408.image_caption: Figure 1 : Training vision models for weight-space programming. (a) Edit-Ready Training (ERT) simulates edits during training to make vision models better editable by LLMs. (b) Through our WeightLab an LLM agent can iteratively edit a vision model’s weights to change its behavior. (c) ERT improves vision model editability through LLMs, which is indicated by an increased mean net edit score over all nine settings, and the gain of ERT over ERM on the three settings that are hardest (bars: 95% bootstrap confidence; ∗ : p < 0.05 p<0.05 ).

2611.26438.image_caption: Figure 1 : Qualitative comparison of RICL and R2-VLA on the LIBERO- Goal task “Put the bowl on top of the cabinet” using π 0 \pi_{0} -FAST. (a) RICL retrieves behaviorally relevant demonstrations from the same task, yet still produces an incorrect action at step 85: instead of moving the bowl toward the cabinet, the policy moves it away from the target. This error leads to continued execution in the wrong direction and ultimately task failure. (b) R2-VLA detects such uncertain actions using its learned uncertainty predictor and requests expert assistance when the predicted uncertainty exceeds the threshold λ ^ \hat{\lambda} , enabling successful task completion.

2611.25088.image_caption: Figure 9 : Grouping the ten structural features into three dimensions eliminates severe within-group collinearity. Pairwise Pearson correlations across the eight public coding benchmarks (log-transformed task medians; blue: positive, lavender: negative). (a) Raw features exhibit near-collinearity within conceptual blocks (e.g., file_count vs. max_dir_depth , r = 0.97 r=0.97 ; files_changed vs. hunks , r = 0.93 r=0.93 ), which destabilizes an ungrouped regression. (b) Aggregating into Repo Scale, Dependency, and Bug Patch z-score averages lowers the maximum off-diagonal correlation to r = 0.82 r=0.82 while keeping Bug Patch nearly orthogonal to both repository-level groups ( r = 0.15 r=0.15 and − 0.03 -0.03 ).

2611.25179.image_caption: Figure 1: A checker validated on the expert can be wrong elsewhere. On the expert demonstration (left), the checker agrees with the instruction. On other executions (right), the same checker accepts a bottle that is lifted but not shaken, and rejects two bottles that are picked up away from the centre.

2611.25360.image_caption: Figure 1: Overview of AppSci-Bench. We evaluate how the Applied Scientist (2) builds an artifact system (3) by eliciting requirements from a simulated business user (1). The best artifact is scored on a held-out test suite (4) using new data and scenarios to assess generalization.

2611.25582.image_caption: Fig. 1: Building a RAG assistant for internal documents. Developers spend considerable time and effort implementing, testing, and refining RAG methods, whereas an LLM agent can efficiently refine the system over successive iterations.
